build.beforeBuildCommand: bash -lc 'search="$PWD"; while [ "$search" != "/" ]; do for candidate in "$search/scripts/prepare-build.sh" "$search/apps/tauri-shell/scripts/prepare-build.sh"; do if [ -f "$candidate" ]; then exec bash "$candidate"; fi; done; search="$(dirname "$search")"; done; echo "prepare-build.sh not found from $PWD" >&2; exit 1'

security.csp: default-src 'self'; connect-src 'self' ws://127.0.0.1:* http://127.0.0.1:* ipc: http://ipc.localhost; script-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; img-src 'self' data: blob:; font-src 'self' data:

bundle.shortDescription: quanta — multi-surface coding agent desktop shell
bundle.longDescription: Desktop shell for quanta. Wraps the web frontend, spawns the local bun daemon, registers a global hotkey, and drives the screen-ocr sidecar for window capture.
